nodes.name: Oath alliances
nodes.emerged: undated pre-literate practice (ethnographic analogy); first written attestation ~2,400 BCE in the oaths of the Ebla treaty
nodes.desc: Communities bind themselves in alliance by oath, gifts and marriage. Knowledge only for now: adopting a form of government arrives with the government layer (M8).
capabilities: alliances between communities sealed by oath, gifts and intermarriage

nodes.name: Envoys and diplomatic letters
nodes.emerged: ~2,400 BCE Ebla (royal letter to Hamazi); ~1,350 BCE Amarna correspondence
nodes.desc: Accredited envoys carry sealed letters between rulers. Knowledge only for now: adopting a form of government arrives with the government layer (M8).
capabilities: accredited envoys carrying sealed letters between rulers

nodes.name: Land held for service
nodes.emerged: ~1,750 BCE Babylon (ilku service-land in Hammurabi's laws); later fiefs and Ottoman timars
nodes.desc: Land is granted in return for military service. Knowledge only for now: adopting a form of government arrives with the government layer (M8).
capabilities: land grants held in return for military service

nodes.name: Sworn treaties
nodes.emerged: ~2,400 BCE Ebla–Abarsal treaty; ~1,259 BCE Egyptian–Hittite treaty
nodes.desc: Written treaties, sworn before the gods, bind both parties. Knowledge only for now: adopting a form of government arrives with the government layer (M8).
capabilities: written treaties sworn before the gods and kept by both parties

nodes.name: Standing army
nodes.emerged: ~2,300 BCE Akkad (permanent royal troops); ~740 BCE Assyria (Tiglath-Pileser III)
nodes.desc: A permanent army is paid and supplied by the state. Knowledge only for now: adopting a form of government arrives with the government layer (M8).
capabilities: a permanent army paid and supplied by the state

nodes.name: Law of nations
nodes.emerged: 1625 CE Grotius, On the Law of War and Peace; 1648 CE Peace of Westphalia
nodes.desc: A law among sovereign states governs envoys, treaties, neutrality and war. Knowledge only for now: adopting a form of government arrives with the government layer (M8).
capabilities: a law among sovereign states on envoys, treaties, neutrality and war

nodes.name: Resident embassies
nodes.emerged: ~1450 CE resident ambassadors among the Italian states
nodes.desc: Ambassadors reside permanently at foreign courts. Knowledge only for now: adopting a form of government arrives with the government layer (M8).
capabilities: permanent ambassadors resident at foreign courts

nodes.name: General staff
nodes.emerged: 1806–1814 CE Prussian staff reforms; 1810 CE Prussian war academy
nodes.desc: A permanent staff of officers plans mobilization and operations. Knowledge only for now: adopting a form of government arrives with the government layer (M8).
capabilities: a permanent staff of officers planning mobilization and operations

nodes.name: Laws of war conventions
nodes.emerged: 1863 CE Lieber Code; 1864 CE first Geneva Convention; 1899 CE Hague Convention
nodes.desc: International conventions protect the wounded, prisoners and civilians in war. Knowledge only for now: adopting a form of government arrives with the government layer (M8).
capabilities: multilateral conventions protecting the wounded, prisoners and civilians

nodes.name: Universal conscription
nodes.emerged: 1793 CE French levée en masse; 1798 CE Jourdan Law
nodes.desc: Young men are registered and called up for military service. Knowledge only for now: adopting a form of government arrives with the government layer (M8).
capabilities: compulsory military service by registration and annual call-up

nodes.name: War bands
nodes.emerged: ~13 kya Jebel Sahaba
nodes.desc: Kin groups raise armed parties for raids and feuds under a chosen leader.
capabilities: kin groups raise armed parties for raids and feuds under a chosen leader

nodes.name: Dynastic marriage
nodes.emerged: ~1,350 BCE Amarna letters
nodes.desc: Royal houses marry to seal alliances and claims.
capabilities: royal houses marry to seal alliances and claims

nodes.name: Trade treaties
nodes.emerged: ~2,300 BCE Ebla–Abarsal treaty; ~1,900 BCE Assur–Kanesh agreements
nodes.desc: Rulers agree by oath on merchants' safety, tolls and courts.
capabilities: rulers agree by oath on merchants' safety, tolls and courts

nodes.name: Citizen militia
nodes.emerged: ~650 BCE hoplite phalanx
nodes.desc: Citizens arm themselves and serve as heavy infantry in their city's army.
capabilities: citizens arm themselves and serve as heavy infantry in their city's army

nodes.name: Daughter colonies
nodes.emerged: ~814 BCE Carthage; ~750 BCE Greek apoikiai
nodes.desc: A city sends settlers overseas to found a new self-governing city linked by cult and kinship.
capabilities: a city sends settlers overseas to found a new self-governing city linked by cult and kinship

nodes.name: State navy
nodes.emerged: ~700 BCE Phoenician royal fleets; ~483 BCE Athenian naval programme
nodes.desc: The state builds, crews and pays a permanent war fleet.
capabilities: the state builds, crews and pays a permanent war fleet

nodes.name: Mercenary contracts
nodes.emerged: ~401 BCE the Ten Thousand; ~1,350 CE condottieri
nodes.desc: Rulers hire professional soldiers by contract for pay.
capabilities: rulers hire professional soldiers by contract for pay

nodes.name: Tributary relations
nodes.emerged: ~198 BCE Han–Xiongnu heqin; ~50 BCE Han tributary missions
nodes.desc: Lesser rulers send tribute and receive gifts and titles from a central court.
capabilities: lesser rulers send tribute and receive gifts and titles from a central court

nodes.name: Military orders
nodes.emerged: ~1,119 CE Knights Templar
nodes.desc: Religious brotherhoods of knights hold castles and fight under a rule.
capabilities: religious brotherhoods of knights hold castles and fight under a rule

nodes.name: Colonial administration
nodes.emerged: ~1,524 CE Council of the Indies
nodes.desc: Distant territories are ruled by a home council, viceroys and colonial law.
capabilities: distant territories are ruled by a home council, viceroys and colonial law

nodes.name: Military academies
nodes.emerged: ~1,741 CE Royal Military Academy, Woolwich
nodes.desc: Officers are trained in schools of tactics, engineering and gunnery.
capabilities: officers are trained in schools of tactics, engineering and gunnery

nodes.name: State-sponsored exploration
nodes.emerged: ~1,405 CE Zheng He's fleets; ~1,415 CE Portuguese voyages
nodes.desc: The crown funds and charters voyages of discovery and claims what they find.
capabilities: the crown funds and charters voyages of discovery and claims what they find

nodes.name: State sovereignty system
nodes.emerged: ~1,648 CE Peace of Westphalia
nodes.desc: States recognize each other as equal sovereigns with exclusive authority at home.
capabilities: states recognize each other as equal sovereigns with exclusive authority at home

nodes.name: Concert of powers
nodes.emerged: ~1,815 CE Congress of Vienna
nodes.desc: The great powers meet in congress to settle disputes and keep a balance.
capabilities: the great powers meet in congress to settle disputes and keep a balance

nodes.name: Indirect rule
nodes.emerged: ~1,858 CE Indian princely states; ~1,900 CE Northern Nigeria
nodes.desc: A colonial power rules through local rulers bound by treaty and resident advisers.
capabilities: a colonial power rules through local rulers bound by treaty and resident advisers

nodes.name: International organizations
nodes.emerged: ~1,865 CE International Telegraph Union; ~1,874 CE Universal Postal Union
nodes.desc: States create permanent bodies with secretariats to run shared affairs.
capabilities: states create permanent bodies with secretariats to run shared affairs

nodes.name: Settler land grants
nodes.emerged: ~1,862 CE Homestead Act
nodes.desc: Public land is surveyed and granted to settlers who farm it.
capabilities: public land is surveyed and granted to settlers who farm it

nodes.name: Arms control
nodes.emerged: ~1,968 CE Non-Proliferation Treaty; ~1,972 CE SALT I
nodes.desc: States cap and verify their weapons by treaty.
capabilities: states cap and verify their weapons by treaty

nodes.name: Collective security
nodes.emerged: ~1,919 CE League of Nations; ~1,945 CE UN Charter
nodes.desc: Members pledge to act together against an aggressor.
capabilities: members pledge to act together against an aggressor

nodes.name: Decolonization
nodes.emerged: ~1,947 CE Indian independence; ~1,960 CE UN Resolution 1514
nodes.desc: Colonies win independence under a doctrine of self-determination of peoples.
capabilities: colonies win independence under a doctrine of self-determination of peoples

nodes.name: Integrated alliance command
nodes.emerged: ~1,949 CE North Atlantic Treaty; ~1,951 CE SHAPE
nodes.desc: Allies place forces under a joint peacetime command.
capabilities: allies place forces under a joint peacetime command

nodes.name: Nuclear deterrence doctrine
nodes.emerged: ~1,954 CE massive retaliation doctrine
nodes.desc: War is to be prevented by the threat of nuclear retaliation.
capabilities: war is to be prevented by the threat of nuclear retaliation

nodes.name: Total mobilization
nodes.emerged: ~1,914 CE general mobilization
nodes.desc: The whole economy and manpower of the state are directed to war.
capabilities: the whole economy and manpower of the state are directed to war
